MK-CF-F-018: Allocates a level annual run-rate using all vest months and ignores which calendar year actually vests. It silently puts undated vesting in December.
MK-CF-F-160: Elapsed milliseconds rounded to days does not define calendar-day behavior across daylight saving time and non-midnight timestamps.
MK-CF-F-124: The revised rule deliberately leaves earlier days in the current month in the past, despite a purpose that says next occurrence on/after now. Leap-day rollover is also unspecified.

MK-CF-F-019: Undated annual categories are spread over twelve months by the budget reader but placed wholly in January here. The relationship to conservative availability is clear, but bill timing/unknown coverage is inconsistent.

MK-CF-F-020: Uses one rate against all taxed income without subtracting 401(k)s, includes reinvested dividends in inflow, and omits debt outflow. Its own take-home promise differs from the current shared grid.
MK-CF-O-006: The prose rounds the share before describing threshold status, unlike creditUtilization’s explicit pre-rounding classification.

formula_checks.name: whatsComing
formula_checks.why: Composes the declared grid and bill reader, inheriting bill-date ambiguity and unknown starting-balance assumptions.
formula_checks.should_be: Carry starting-balance assumption and unknown bill dates to the visible projection, then reuse corrected upcomingBills.

formula_checks.name: receivedInMonth
formula_checks.why: Filters the requested recorded year-month and sorts newest first; this is month membership, not a guarantee that every record is before an in-month as-of time.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: zero12
formula_checks.why: A structural zero accumulator, not a claim about missing user financial data.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: equityByMonth
formula_checks.why: Allocates a level annual run-rate using all vest months and ignores which calendar year actually vests. It silently puts undated vesting in December.
formula_checks.should_be: Read year-specific vested values for actual months, or clearly label an illustrative run-rate.

formula_checks.name: daysBetweenDates
formula_checks.why: Elapsed milliseconds rounded to days does not define calendar-day behavior across daylight saving time and non-midnight timestamps.
formula_checks.should_be: Declare whole local calendar dates versus elapsed 24-hour periods; normalize the former before subtraction.

formula_checks.name: addDays
formula_checks.why: Moves by local calendar days; day and offset must be preserved across DST rather than blindly adding 24-hour milliseconds.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: nextOccurrence
formula_checks.why: The revised rule deliberately leaves earlier days in the current month in the past, despite a purpose that says next occurrence on/after now. Leap-day rollover is also unspecified.
formula_checks.should_be: Name it current-cycle occurrence or implement true next occurrence; settle February 29 in nonleap years. Preserve the owner’s current-month bill rule at its caller.

formula_checks.name: upcomingBills
formula_checks.why: Undated annual categories are spread over twelve months by the budget reader but placed wholly in January here. The relationship to conservative availability is clear, but bill timing/unknown coverage is inconsistent.
formula_checks.should_be: Use one dated bill schedule or flag unentered due months; keep same-day bill allocation stable and avoid inventing January.

formula_checks.name: balanceByDay
formula_checks.why: Implements the documented conservative availability policy: prior End plus dated items, counting undated regular money only when negative. It is a conservative projection, not a measured daily balance.

formula_checks.name: cashflowYear
formula_checks.why: Uses one rate against all taxed income without subtracting 401(k)s, includes reinvested dividends in inflow, and omits debt outflow. Its own take-home promise differs from the current shared grid.
formula_checks.should_be: Use the same monthly take-home after contributions, dividend cash treatment, and dated debts as datedGridOf.

formula_checks.name: theCreditLine
formula_checks.why: The prose rounds the share before describing threshold status, unlike creditUtilization’s explicit pre-rounding classification.
formula_checks.should_be: Classify on full-precision balance/limit, then round only for display; preserve refusal for absent/nonpositive limit.
